verdict.rationale: Clara documents a Card Configurations API that adds merchant-category, time and day-of-week restrictions to cards, which can be combined. Cards can also be locked or unlocked manually and auto-deleted after an end date. That covers category controls and some lifecycle locking, but the evidence never addresses per-merchant or amount limits, or explicitly states that out-of-policy spend is declined at the point of sale. missing for 10: amount/spend-limit controls, specific-merchant restrictions, explicit point-of-sale decline or auto-lock behavior, independent or hands-on corroboration.
